title: Brand growth programme for the 2027 season
subtitle: A twelve-week engagement covering positioning, campaign production and paid acquisition, built to move qualified pipeline rather than impressions.
pricingNote: Fees are fixed for the scope described in section 02. Media spend is billed separately at cost and is not included above. Any change to scope is quoted before work begins.

overview.heading: What we understand about the problem
overview.lede: You are spending on acquisition, but attribution stops at the click and nobody can say which campaigns produce revenue. This proposal fixes the measurement first, then rebuilds the campaigns on top of it.
overview.note: Rebuilding creative before attribution works means judging the new campaigns with the same broken data. We sequence it the other way round.

scope.heading: What is included
scope.intro: The engagement runs in three workstreams. Each has a named deliverable and a date, so progress is visible without a status meeting.

items.title: Measurement and attribution
items.body: Event tracking audit, server-side event forwarding, and a single reporting view that ties spend to qualified leads rather than to clicks.

items.title: Positioning and messaging
items.body: Customer interviews, competitor message audit, and a one-page positioning statement that every campaign is written against.

items.title: Creative production
items.body: Twelve static concepts and four short-form video edits per month, produced against the positioning and refreshed on performance data.

items.title: Paid acquisition management
items.body: Campaign build, daily budget management and weekly optimisation across the three agreed channels, with pre-committed kill and scale rules.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: A weekly one-page report showing spend, qualified leads, cost per qualified lead and the decisions taken that week.

timeline.heading: How the twelve weeks run
timeline.intro: Dates below assume a start within two weeks of signature and timely access to analytics and ad accounts.

phases.title: Audit and access
phases.body: Tracking audit, account access, baseline metrics agreed in writing.

phases.title: Measurement rebuild
phases.body: Server-side events live, reporting view signed off, baseline locked.

phases.title: First creative cycle
phases.body: Concepts produced, campaigns launched, first optimisation round.

phases.title: Scale and handover
phases.body: Winners scaled, losers cut, documentation and handover pack delivered.

terms.title: Payment schedule
terms.body: Forty per cent on signature, thirty per cent at week six, thirty per cent on delivery. Invoices are due fourteen days from issue.

terms.title: Scope changes
terms.body: Work outside section 02 is quoted separately and begins only after written approval. No change is billed without it.

terms.title: Ownership
terms.body: All deliverables transfer to the client on final payment, including source files, ad accounts and documentation.

terms.title: Confidentiality
terms.body: Both parties keep commercial information confidential during the engagement and for two years afterwards.

terms.title: Termination
terms.body: Either party may terminate with fourteen days written notice. Work completed to that date is invoiced; unused fees are refunded.
